name: core--bedrooms-night-fixed-cooling
description: BedroomS comfort-band automation gains a toggle-gated night fixed-cooling mode: at summer_night_window start (19:30) with the new input_boolean.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling on and the room not away, force continuous cool at a tunable AC-setpoint (default 24C) instead of the normal on/off/fan_only/coil-cooldown cycling, reverting to normal cycling automatically once the toggle/window condition no longer holds.

changes: New time trigger summer_night_fixed_cooling_start at 19:30:00 on automation.test_aircon_bedrooms_room_sensor_comfort_band

New choose branch 'Summer: night fixed-cooling' — on trigger, if climate_mode is summer, toggle is on, and not away: climate.set_hvac_mode cool + climate.set_temperature reading input_number.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling_target (default 24, per AC-vs-room-sensor calibration offset)

Guard clause `and not (summer_night_window and is_state('input_boolean.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling', 'on') and not away)` appended to the existing 'Summer: cool when room is above target comfort band', 'Summer: coil cool-down after target is reached', and 'Summer: turn off after coil cool-down' branches so old cycling logic is suppressed for the night
No guard needed on 'Night: sleep keeps climate off' — already inert Mar-Nov via the 2026-07-24 calendar guard
No import.tf change — helpers and the my-dash lovelace dashboard are live-only, never Terraform-managed

Live-first: applied via tools/home-assistant-live/apply_bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling.js (creates input_boolean.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling, off by default), then backported into main.tf as a second, additive-only commit on top of a separate reconciliation commit that closed pre-existing main.tf/live drift from the 2026-07-24 incident fix

Follow-up: the 24C setpoint was initially hardcoded with no UI control, inconsistent with every other comfort-band target in this automation. tools/home-assistant-live/apply_bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling_target_control.js added input_number.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling_target (18-30 range, step 0.5, default 24) and rewired the action to a template reading it; also added to the Night card in my-dash, right after the toggle

Follow-up 2: the original design only fired at the fixed 19:30 trigger (edge-triggered, no self-heal) — toggling on after 19:30 had no effect until the next day, which surprised the user in live use. tools/home-assistant-live/apply_bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling_toggle_trigger.js added a state trigger on the toggle turning on (id night_fixed_cooling_toggle_on) and extended the branch condition to trigger.id in [both ids] plus an explicit summer_night_window check (previously only implied by the 19:30 trigger.id match)

checks: git diff --stat on main.tf shows only additive changes scoped to the BedroomS resource block: 37 insertions/3 deletions for the feature commit, 1 insertion/1 deletion for the target-control follow-up
Brace/bracket balance in main.tf verified balanced after each patch, matching the new JSON structures added
grep counts within the BedroomS block: 1x new choose-branch alias, 2x trigger id (definition + condition usage), 3x suppression guard clause (one per suppressed branch)
Live: /api/template check on the 3 patched branch templates and the new branch's template returned HTTP 200 (valid Jinja, no syntax errors)
Live: automation.test_aircon_bedrooms_room_sensor_comfort_band state is 'on' after each apply (POST-config side effect of disabling it was worked around with an explicit automation/turn_on call)
input_boolean.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling created, off by default; input_number.bedrooms_night_fixed_cooling_target created, value 24.0 — both confirmed via /api/states
Live: climate.set_temperature action's data.temperature confirmed as the template string reading the input_number, not a literal, via /api/config/automation/config
Live: my-dash 'BedS Tune' view's 'Night' card entities list confirmed via lovelace/config WS query to include both the toggle and the new target control, in order
terraform validate not run — hashicorp/homeassistant provider not installed in this environment; structural checks above substitute

Live: user enabled the toggle mid-window (after 19:30) on 2026-07-27 and the AC did not turn on — root cause confirmed edge-triggered design, fixed via follow-up 2. AC manually forced to cool/24C for that night as a one-off catch-up; the toggle-trigger fix covers all future mid-window enables. Verified via /api/states: automation state 'on', condition template applied, toggle-trigger present in triggers array
Not yet observed: a real 19:30 clock trigger end-to-end, and not yet observed the new toggle-triggered path end-to-end (only structural + live-apply verification so far)
